title: Cover plain unprefixed mailbox display names in MCP refusal tests
outcome: MCP display-name refusal tests cover FederationMailboxAlias::Name in addition to Legacy names, including successful selection, missing and ambiguous names before append.
acceptance: Behavioral tests exercise a plain unprefixed display name without :: resolving to a domain row and assert refusal with the listed remedy before any append.
Plain-name missing and ambiguous fixtures assert their actual selector errors and zero append, preserving existing Legacy, explicit alias and exact-id controls.
